Interface IheFhirProfile

All Known Implementing Classes:
MhdProfile, PdqmProfile, PixmProfile
public interface IheFhirProfile
Common interface for IHE FHIR profile enumerations. Provides default implementations for common profile operations.
Since:
5.2

  • Field Details

    • IHE_ITI_PREFIX

      static final String IHE_ITI_PREFIX
      Common prefix of the canonical URLs of the IHE ITI profiles. A constant expression, so that the constants built from it remain usable in annotations and in enum constant arguments.
      See Also:
